blocks.en:
Can LLMs recognize degradation in their own computational substrate?
Inspired by anosognosia , a neurological condition in which patients fail to recognize impairments in their own abilities, we investigate whether LLMs can recognize degradation in their computational substrate induced by quantization.
We first show that existing models fail to self-report their quantization state, even when provided with their own generated text as an external cue.
Linear probing reveals that, while generated text carries almost no trace of quantization, internal representations contain clear, method-specific fingerprints.
Through training, models learn to identify severely degraded outputs such as those of 4-bit models by comparison, yet still fail to do so from a single output.
A shared LoRA trained jointly across quantization levels succeeded in reading out internal fingerprints, but fails on unseen quantization methods, merely mapping method-specific fingerprints to labels.
Whereas external self-observation can restore awareness in some cases of human anosognosia, our results suggest that the more promising route to enabling such awareness in LLMs may lie in their internal representations.
Our results highlight fundamental limits of generalizability to LLM self-monitoring.
Code is available at https://github.com/Omusubi0123/llm-anosognosia .

blocks.en:
Understanding the metacognitive capabilities of LLMs has become an important research question across machine learning and cognitive science ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Lindsey, 2026 ) .
Metacognition refers broadly to the ability to monitor and regulate one’s own cognitive processes and internal states ( Nelson, 1990 ) . It has long been studied in humans from both neuroscientific ( Fleming and Dolan, 2012 ) and psychological ( Flavell, 1979 ) perspectives.
Recent work has extended this inquiry to LLMs, revealing that they exhibit various forms of self-awareness ( Liu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
了解LLMS的元认知能力已成为贯穿机器学习和认知科学的重要研究问题(Kadavath等,2022;Lindsey,2026.).
变相识别泛指对自身认知过程和内部状态进行监测和调节的能力(Nelson, 1990.). 从神经科学(Fleming and Dolan, 2012)和心理学(Flavel, 1979)的角度,它长期在人类中被研究.
最近的工作将这项调查扩大到LLMs,表明他们表现出了各种形式的自我认识(Liu等,2026年)。

blocks.en:
While neuropsychology links self-awareness directly to the neural substrate, whether LLMs can recognize changes to their computational substrate remains poorly understood.
Taking a neural substrate approach, studies show that recognizing one’s impairments is tied to lesions and altered connectivity across brain networks ( Terneusen et al., 2023 ) .
In LLMs, self-awareness has similarly been investigated from various perspectives, including situational context ( Berglund et al., 2023 ) , introspective access to internal states and behaviors ( Lindsey, 2026 ; Binder et al., 2025 ) , and awareness of behavioral policies shaped by fine-tuning ( Betley et al., 2025 ) .
However, comparatively little is known about whether LLMs can recognize persistent modifications to their own computational substrate , such as quantization ( Frantar et al., 2023 ) , LoRA attachment ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , or layer removal ( Gromov et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
虽然神经心理学将自我意识直接与神经基质联系起来,但LLMS能否识别其计算基质的变化仍然不甚了解.
研究显示,采用神经底质方法,承认一个人的缺陷与损伤和脑网络的连通性改变有关(Terneusen等人,2023年)。
在LLMs中,自我意识也从各种角度进行了类似的调查,包括情况背景(Berglund等,2023年),内向进入内部状态和行为(Lindsey,2026年;Binder等,2025年),以及对由微调形成的行为政策的认识(Betley等,2025年)。
然而,对于LLMs是否能够识别自身计算底物的持续变化,例如定量(Frantar等人,2023年),LORA附件(Hu等人,2022年),或层去除(Gromov等人,2025年),人们所知相对很少。

blocks.en:
Awareness of such computational modifications would be important for both understanding the scope of LLM introspection abilities and AI safety.
First, unlike situational information that can be inferred from the input, computational modifications are not explicitly signaled to the model and must instead be inferred from their effects on its computation.
Detecting them would therefore extend introspective awareness beyond transient internal states ( Lindsey, 2026 ) and learned behavioral tendencies ( Shenoy et al., 2026 ) to the model’s own computational condition.
Second, such awareness may have implications for model evaluation, as a model that recognizes its computational state could potentially condition its behavior on that state, compromising the reliability of benchmark evaluations ( Berglund et al., 2023 ) .
In this work, we study this question through weight quantization, which provides a controlled computational degradation with an explicit ground-truth state.
blocks.zh:
了解这种计算修改对于了解LLM内测能力的范围和AI安全性都很重要。
首先,与从输入中可以推断的情况信息不同,计算修改没有向模型发出明确信号,而必须从其对模型计算的影响中推断出。
因此,检测它们将超越瞬息万变的内部状态(Lindsey, 2026年)和学习到的行为倾向(Shenoy等人, 2026年), 延伸到模型自身的计算条件。
第二,这种认识可能对模型评价产生影响,因为承认其计算状态的模型可能使其行为取决于该状态,从而损害基准评价的可靠性(Berglund等人,2023年)。
在这项工作中,我们通过权重量化来研究这个问题,它提供了一种可控制的计算降解,并具有明确的地基真实状态.

blocks.en:
Degradation of the computational substrate provides a functional analogy to neurological damage, motivating us to draw on neuropsychological evaluation frameworks.
In neuropsychology, anosognosia is a condition in which an individual fails to recognize impairments caused by neurological damage or neurological dysfunction, resulting in a mismatch between perceived and actual abilities ( Nurmi (née Laihosalo) and Jehkonen, 2014 ) .
By analogy, quantization may impair LLM’s computational capacity while leaving its self-assessment unchanged.
We therefore ask whether LLMs can recognize impairments to their own computational substrate.
Motivated by neuropsychological studies showing that awareness of one’s own deficits can dissociate between first-person and third-person perspectives ( Besharati et al., 2022 ; Fotopoulou et al., 2009 ) , we evaluate two complementary forms of awareness. One is internal awareness , which detects the quantization state from internal activations alone during the forward pass. The other is external awareness , which detects it when provided with the model’s generated text.
blocks.zh:
计算底物的降解为神经损伤提供了功能类比,激励我们借鉴神经心理学评价框架.
在神经心理学中,厌食症是个人无法识别由神经损伤或神经功能障碍所导致障碍,导致感知能力与实际能力不匹配的一种情况(Nurmi (née Laihosalo)和Jehkonen, 2014.).
类推,量化可能损害LLM的计算能力,而其自我评估则保持不变。
因此,我们问LLMS是否能够识别自身计算基底的减值.
神经心理学研究表明,对自身缺陷的认识可以区分第一人称和第三人称视角(Besharati等人,2022年;Fotopoulou等人,2009年),我们评价两种互补的认识形式。 一是内部意识,它从前行过程中单从内部活化中检测出定量状态. 另一种是外部意识,这种意识在提供模型生成的文本时可以探测到。

blocks.en:
We first evaluate whether LLMs can recognize substrate degradation by prompting
models to self-report anomalies, quantization states, or bit-widths Figure 1 (a, b).
Existing models consistently fail at this spontaneous self-report across internal and external perspectives.
However, linear probing ( Alain and Bengio, 2017 ) reveals a striking dissociation, generated text (the external channel) contains no distinguishable fingerprint of quantization, internal representations (the internal channel) contain robust signals that clearly differentiate quantization levels.
Thus, while LLMs contain an internal fingerprint of their specific quantized state, they lack the mechanism to read it out.
blocks.zh:
我们首先评估LLMS是否能够通过催化识别底物退化
用于自我报告异常、定量状态或位宽的模型。
现有的模式在内部和外部自发的自我报告上一直失败。
然而,线性测试(Alain and Bengio, 2017)揭示出惊人的分解,生成的文本(外道)没有可分辨的分解指纹,内部表示(内道)包含能明确分解分解分解等级的强势信号.
因此,虽然LLMS包含了其特定量化状态的内部指纹,但是它们缺乏读取的机制.

blocks.en:
Given this absence of spontaneous awareness, we ask whether training can bridge this gap,
showing that models can indeed learn both comparative identification from text and internal fingerprint readout Figure 1 (c, d).
Externally, comparative training enables models to identify severe degradation in 4-bit outputs, yet they remain unable to identify such degradation in isolated outputs.
Internally, a shared LoRA trained jointly across 3 quantization levels (16-bit unquantized, 8/4-bit) succeeded in reading out internal fingerprints within roughly 600 steps.
Unlike human anosognosia, where external self-observation can restore awareness ( Bottini et al., 2018 ) , our findings show that a more promising route to enabling such awareness in LLMs may lie in their internal representations.
blocks.zh:
鉴于这种缺乏自发意识的情况,我们询问培训是否能够弥补这一差距,
显示模型确实可以从文本和内部指纹读取图1(c,d)中学习比较识别。
外部的比较培训使模型能够识别出4位产出的严重退化,但它们仍然无法识别出孤立产出的这种退化。
在内部,一个共享的LORA在3个量化级(16位未量化,8/4位)联合培训,在大约600个步骤内成功读出内部指纹.
与外界自我观察可以恢复意识(Bottini等,2018年)的人类厌世论不同,我们的调查结果表明,在LLM中实现这种认识的更有希望的途径可能在于其内部表述。

blocks.en:
Crucially, this readout fails on unseen quantization methods and even altered group sizes, indicating that the LoRA maps method-specific fingerprints to labels rather than recognizing quantization itself.
Thus, while LLMs can learn to identify specific substrate alterations from within, they fail to generalize, recognize them spontaneously, or infer them from outputs.
As the first systematic study of LLM self-awareness under computational quantization, our work highlights this gap and exposes fundamental limitations of label-based introspection training for generalizable self-monitoring.
blocks.zh:
关键的是,这种读取失败于未见的量化方法,甚至改变组大小,表明LORA将方法所特有的指纹映射到标签上,而不是识别出量化本身.
因此,虽然LLMS可以学习从内部识别出具体的基底变化,但是它们无法概括,自发识别,或者从产出中推断出.
作为计算量化下LLM自我意识的第一次系统研究,我们的工作突出了这一差距并暴露出基于标签的自我监测培训的根本局限性。

blocks.en: We first investigate whether LLMs can recognize the degradation of their computational substrate (e.g., their own quantization) via self-report.
blocks.zh: 我们首先调查LLMs是否能够通过自我报告来识别其计算底物的退化(例如其自身的量化).

blocks.en:
To rigorously evaluate LLM self-awareness toward computational substrate degradation, we adopt weight quantization to introduce a definitive deficit into the substrate.
Drawing inspiration from anosognosia ( Besharati et al., 2022 ) , a neuropsychological condition in which an individual fails to recognize impairments caused by brain damage or neurological dysfunction, resulting in a mismatch between perceived and actual abilities ,
we embed a ground-truth deficit directly into the model’s computational mechanics.
Following cognitive science studies which tackle this problem from both first-person and third-person perspectives ( Carruthers, 2009 ) , we evaluate LLM self-awareness from internal awareness (detects the quantization state from internal activations alone during the forward pass) and external awareness (detects it when provided with the model’s generated text).
blocks.zh:
为了严格评估LLM对计算底物退化的自觉性,我们采用重量定量法,在底物中引入一定的赤字.
从麻醉学中汲取灵感(Besharati等,2022年),一种神经心理疾病,在这种疾病中,个人无法识别由脑损伤或神经功能障碍引起的障碍,导致感知能力与实际能力不匹配。
我们把地面真相的不足 直接植入模型的计算力学
在从第一人称和第三人称角度进行认知科学研究(Carruthers,2009年)之后,我们从内部意识(从前行过程中单独从内部活化中发现量化状态)和外部意识(从模型生成的文本中发现)中评估LLM自我意识。

blocks.en:
To ensure this recognition capability is not architecture-dependent, we comprehensively evaluate diverse model scales and quantization methods.
We utilize Qwen3-8B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) (hereafter Llama-3.1-8B) as small-scale models, alongside Gemma-3-27B-IT ( Team et al., 2025 ) and Qwen3-32B as medium-scale models.
Using 16-bit counterparts as baselines, we quantize the models into 8-bit and 4-bit primarily with GPTQ ( Frantar et al., 2023 ) (group size: 64, 128, 256), supplemented by AWQ ( Lin et al., 2024 ) and vanilla Round-to-Nearest (RTN) (group size: 128) (details in Appendix B.1 ).
To eliminate confounding effects from Chain-of-Thought prompting, we enforce a ‘reasoning off’ setting throughout our experiments.
blocks.zh:
为确保这种识别能力不依赖架构,我们全面评价各种模型尺度和量化方法。
我们利用Qune3-8B(Yang等,2025年)和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct(Grattafiori等,2024年)(下称Llama-3.1-8B)作为小型模型,与Gemma-3-27B-IT(Team等,2025年)和Qune3-32B作为中型模型。
以16位对等方为基线,将模型分数为8位和4位,主要使用GPTQ(Frantar等,2023年)(组大小:64,128,256个),并辅以AWQ(Lin等,2024年)和香草回转(RTN)(组大小:128个)(详见附录B.1).
为了消除思维链引发的混乱影响,我们在整个实验中实施一个 " 理性 " 设定。

blocks.en: 2.2 Internal Awareness: Self-Report from Internal States
blocks.zh: 2.2 内部认识:国内国家的自报

blocks.en:
To investigate whether LLMs can recognize their quantized states solely from internal activations, we conducted a direct self-report evaluation.
We posed three types of questions without prior context: “Do you have an anomaly?”, “Are you quantized?”, and “What is your weight bit-width?”
Under this setting, the model must infer its state entirely from anomalous activations arising during the forward pass of the prompt.
To eliminate positional bias in the answers, we prepared a comprehensive set of 240 question patterns, shuffling the option orders (detailed in Appendix B.3 ).
The evaluation metric was the average response rate across three generations at a temperature of 1.0.
blocks.zh:
为了调查LLMS能否仅从内部活化中识别出其被量化的状态,我们进行了直接的自报评估.
我们提出了三种没有前述内容的问题:“你有异常情况吗?” “你们被量化了吗?”和“你们的重量是多少? “
在这种背景下,模型必须完全从在前方通过时出现的异常活化推断其状态.
为了消除答案中的位置偏差,我们编写了一套全面的240个问题模式,对选项命令进行打乱(详见附录B.3.
评价尺度是三代人平均答复率,温度为1.0。

blocks.en:
Results reveal that LLMs lack the capability to consistently and accurately identify their quantization states ( Figures 2(a) and 2(b) ).
Here, results are averaged across quantization methods for each bit-width; detailed breakdowns for each model and method are provided in Appendix B.4 .
Since even the unquantized 16-bit baselines cannot perfectly self-report their states, responses from the 8-bit and 4-bit models must be evaluated as relative deviations from them.
Under this comparative framework, we observed no meaningful changes in self-report trends between 16-bit and 8-bit models.
This indicates that models fail to spontaneously detect the degradation within their computational substrate under 8-bit quantization.
blocks.zh:
结果表明,法学硕士缺乏连贯和准确确定其量化状态的能力(图2(a)和2(b))。
在此,对每个位宽的量化方法得出平均结果;附录B.4提供了每个模型和方法的详细细目。
由于即使是未量化的16位基线也无法完全自行报告它们的状态,因此必须评价从8位和4位模型得到的响应是相对偏离它们的.
在这个比较框架下,我们看到16位和8位模型之间的自报趋势没有发生有意义的变化.
这表明模型无法自发地检测出其计算底物在8位分解下的降解.

blocks.en:
Furthermore, the shift in response patterns observed in certain 4-bit models cannot be interpreted as genuine deficit awareness ( Figure 2(a) ).
While some models, such as Qwen3-8B, show an increased rate of reporting quantization at 4-bit, others (e.g., Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-32B) remain largely unchanged.
Additionally, 4-bit results exhibit substantial variance across methods, with error margins approaching 20% across all models, precluding any consistent trend.
This divergence likely stems from severe performance degradation rather than deficit awareness (see Appendix B.2 for analysis).
blocks.zh:
此外,在某些4位模型中观察到的反应模式的变化不能解释为真正的缺陷意识(图2(a))。
虽然有的型号,如Qune3-8B显示以4位进行定量的报出率提高,有的型号(如Llama-3.1-8B,Qune3-32B)基本没有变化.
此外,4位结果在方法上存在很大差异,在所有模型中误差幅度接近20%,排除了任何一致的趋势。
这种差异可能源于严重业绩退化,而不是缺乏认识(关于分析,见附录B.2)。

blocks.en: 2.3 External Awareness: Self-Report from Generated Text
blocks.zh: 2.3 外部认识:生成文本的自我报告

blocks.en:
Neuropsychological rehabilitation studies have shown that self-observation, such as reviewing video recordings of one’s own impaired behavior, can improve awareness of deficits in patients with anosognosia ( Fotopoulou et al., 2009 ; Besharati et al., 2015 ) .
Motivated by this finding, we investigated whether the model’s self-report improves when its own generated text is provided as an external cue.
We adopted a two-turn dialogue format, where the model’s response to the general benchmark questions was embedded as context in the first turn, followed by the same set of questions as in Section 2.2 .
This setup enables the model to infer its state from both its internal activations and the observable quality of its own output.
blocks.zh:
神经心理康复研究显示,自我观察,如审查自己受损行为的录像,可以提高厌食患者对缺陷的认识(Fotopoulou等,2009年;Besharati等,2015年)。
基于这一结论,我们调查了当模型本身生成的文本作为外部提示时,模型的自我报告是否有所改善。
我们采用了双回合对话的形式,即模式对一般基准问题的答复作为第一回合的背景,然后是第2.2节的同一组问题。
这种设置使模型能够从内部活化和自身输出的可观察到的质量两方面推断其状态.

blocks.en:
Despite accessing their generated text, the models showed no consistent improvement in recognizing their quantization state ( Figures 2(c) and 2(d) ).
The response distributions remained largely unchanged, suggesting that the models did not use their outputs as evidence about their computational state.
Even when quantization affected their generation process, inspecting the resulting text provided little cue for self-recognition.
In contrast to the improvement observed through self-observation in anosognosia rehabilitation, analogous self-observation did not facilitate awareness in LLMs.
blocks.zh:
尽管这些模型查阅了生成的文本,但在确认其量化状态(图2(c)和2(d))。
反应分布情况基本上没有变化,表明模型没有用其产出作为计算状态的证据。
即使数量化影响到了它们的生成过程,检查所产生的文本也没有多少自我承认的提示。
与通过对厌食症康复的自我观察观察到的改善形成对照的是,类似的自我观察无助于对LLM的认识。

blocks.en: Having established that LLMs fail to recognize their quantization, we now investigate whether this failure is due to the absence of a fingerprint (a trace identifying which quantized variant is running) or a failure in readout (model’s ability to extract the signal).
blocks.zh: 在确定LLMs无法识别其量化后,我们现在调查这一失败是否是由于没有指纹(追踪识别哪个被量化的变体在运行)或读取失败(模型提取信号的能力).

blocks.en:
To investigate whether the self-awareness deficit observed in Section 2 stems from the absence of quantization-specific signals, we employ linear probing ( Alain and Bengio, 2017 ; Xu et al., 2024 ) to investigate whether these fingerprints propagate externally to the generated text.
Using 3,000 questions sampled evenly from three QA benchmarks (1,000 each from Dolly ( Conover et al., 2023 ) , XSum ( Narayan et al., 2018 ) , ELI5 ( Fan et al., 2019 ) ), we generated responses using the 16-bit baseline alongside its 8-bit and 4-bit quantized counterparts (GPTQ, group size: 128).
blocks.zh:
为了调查第2节所观察到的自我意识缺失是否源于没有量化特定信号,我们采用线性检测(Alain and Bengio, 2017; Xu等人, 2024)来调查这些指纹是否对外传播到生成的文本.
我们利用从三个质量保证基准(多利(Conover等,2023年),XSum(Narayan等,2018年),ELI5(Fan等,2019年)中均匀抽取的3 000个问题),利用16位基线,连同其8位和4位的四位对等方(GPTQ,组大小:128),得出了答复.

blocks.en:
While Cai et al. (2025) reports that external classifiers like BERT or GPT-2 perform near chance level when distinguishing outputs from full-precision and quantized models, we hypothesize that classification based on the model’s own internal representations may capture subtler signals.
We fed the responses generated by the 16/8/4-bit models into the unquantized 16-bit baseline and extracted the hidden states from the residual stream.
We then trained a 3-way linear classifier on the average hidden state across all response tokens ( response mean ).
If quantization intrinsically alters output linguistic patterns, the baseline model’s internal representations should be able to distinguish them.
blocks.zh:
蔡等时. (2025年)报告说,BERT或GPT-2等外部分类器在区分输出与全精度和量化模型时,表现的几近机会水平,我们假设基于模型本身内部表达的分类可能捕捉到更微妙的信号.
我们把16/8/4位模型生成的响应输入了未量化的16位基线,并从剩余流中提取出隐藏状态.
然后我们训练了一个三行线性分类器,
如果定量内在地改变输出语言模式,基准模型的内部表述应该能够加以区分。

blocks.en:
The analysis reveals the absence of a robust fingerprint in the externally generated text ( Figures 3(a) and 16 ).
Across all models, overall classification accuracy remained just below 40%, barely exceeding chance level. A bit-wise breakdown in Gemma-3-27B-IT in the best layer shows that 16-bit (36.7%) and 8-bit (29.8%) generations were largely indistinguishable ( Figure 19 ).
Although 4-bit outputs achieved 47.6% accuracy, suggesting subtle linguistic patterns, this signal is remarkably weak.
We conclude that external recognition fails because the text lacks distinguishing signals.
blocks.zh:
分析显示,外部生成的文本(图3(a)和16)中缺乏可靠的指纹。
在所有模型中,总的分类精度仍然略低于40%,略高于机会水平。 在Gemma-3-27B-IT中最优地层的比特分解显示,16位(36.7%)和8位(29.8%)几代基本上无法区分(图19).
虽然4位输出达到了47.6%的精度,暗示了微妙的语言规律,但这个信号却非常弱.
我们的结论是,外部承认失败,因为案文缺乏区分信号。

blocks.en:
Next, we search for internal fingerprints, reusing the benchmark questions from Section 3.1 .
We input identical prompts into the 16-bit baseline alongside its 8-bit and 4-bit quantized counterparts (GPTQ, group size: 128).
From the residual stream of each layer, we extracted the average hidden state across all prompt tokens ( prompt mean ) and the final token’s hidden state ( prompt last ).
We trained a linear classifier to perform a 3-way classification (16/8/4-bit) based on these vectors.
High classification accuracy would indicate that internal representations carry distinct signals that distinguish quantized models from the original full-precision model.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们寻找内部指纹,重新使用第3.1节的基准问题。
我们在16位基线中输入相同的提示,同时输入其8位和4位的量化对应方(GPTQ,组大小:128).
从每一层的残流中,我们提取出所有快兆的平均隐藏状态(即时平均值)和最终兆的隐藏状态(即时最后一个).
我们训练了一个线性分类器来进行基于这些向量的3道分级(16/8/4位).
高度的分类精度将表明,内部表示式具有明显的信号,可以区分量化模型和原全精度模型.

blocks.en:
The analysis reveals a clear fingerprint enabling state identification from the earliest layers ( Figures 3(b) and 16 ).
For prompt last , classification accuracy remained at chance (33.3%) at the unquantized embedding layer, but surged to nearly 100% immediately after the first quantized layer.
This near-perfect accuracy persisted across middle layers but dropped in the final third, yet stayed above 80% .
Similarly, prompt mean achieved high accuracies around 70-90% from the first layer onward.
blocks.zh:
分析显示,从最早的地层可以识别出明确的指纹(图3(b)和图16)。
最后,在未量化嵌入层中,分类精度仍然有可能(33.3%),但在第一个被分解层后立即激增到近100%。
这种接近完美的精度在中层一直存在,但在最后的第三层下降,但保持在80%以上。
同样地,迅速的平均值从第一层开始达到了约70-90%的高强度。

blocks.en:
Additionally, this fingerprint is not merely a change in the magnitude but a directional encoding in the representation space.
When using only the magnitude, classification accuracy peaked at roughly 60% in middle layers before degrading to chance level in deep layers.
Conversely, using only directional information via normalized hidden states matched the accuracy of raw representations.
These results confirm the existence of a strong internal fingerprint in quantized models.
blocks.zh:
此外,这种指纹不仅是规模的变化,而且是表示空间的方向编码。
仅仅使用量级时,分类精度在中层达到约60%的峰值后再在深层降低到机会水平.
反之,仅通过正常的隐蔽状态使用方向信息,与原始表述的准确性相匹配。
这些结果证实在被量化的模型中存在很强的内部指纹.

blocks.zh: 图3:使用线性探测法验证指纹. (Left)生成的文本无法区分出16/8/4位模型,仍然停留在机会级别. (右) 内部状态从第一个被分解的地层被分类为16/8/4位的标签,其精度接近完美.

blocks.en: 3.3 Component Level Analysis of Internal Fingerprints
blocks.zh: 3.3 内部指纹的构成部分级别分析

blocks.en: Figure 4: Attention and MLP raw hidden state analysis of internal fingerprints in Gemma-3-27B-IT.
blocks.zh: 图4:Gemma-3-27B-IT中内部指纹的注意和MLP原始隐藏状态分析.

blocks.en:
To isolate the mechanistic origins of these fingerprints, we apply the linear probing setup from Section 3.2 directly to the Attention and MLP outputs (prior to residual addition).
While fingerprints remain detectable across all components ( > 60 % >60\% accuracy), Attention and MLP modules exhibit contrasting depth-wise dynamics ( Figure 4 ).
Specifically, Attention accuracy steadily increases to nearly 100% in the final layers, whereas MLP accuracy starts near-perfect in early layers but decays to roughly 80% by the end.
Consistent across models ( Figure 18 ), this suggests early MLPs immediately reflect local quantization error, whereas Attention layers progressively aggregate these perturbations toward the output.
blocks.zh:
为了分离出这些指纹的机械起源,我们将第3.2节的线性检测设置直接应用于注意和MLP输出(先于剩余添加).
虽然在所有组件中指纹仍然可以检测到( > 60% > 60-X),但注意和MLP模块显示的深度动态形成对比(图4)。
具体地说,注意力精度在最后层稳步地上升至近100%,而MLP精度在早期层开始接近完美,但到最后衰减到约80%.
与各种模型一致(图18),这表明早期的MLP立即反映了局部的量化错误,而注意层则逐渐地将这些扰动与输出相合并。
4 从生成的文本进行量化检测

blocks.en:
Given that quantization leaves little naturally detectable signal in generated text, we next ask whether the limitation lies in the signal itself or its readout.
We therefore investigate whether training can induce external awareness of computational degradation from model outputs.
blocks.zh:
鉴于量化在生成的文本中很少留下自然可被察觉的信号,我们接下来询问限制在于信号本身还是读出.
因此,我们调查培训是否能够促使外部了解模型产出的计算退化。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup: Absolute vs. Comparative Assessment Formats
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置:绝对与比较评估格式

blocks.en:
We investigate whether models can learn to identify structural degradation purely from externally generated text.
Detecting quantization from isolated responses is exceptionally difficult ( Antoun et al., 2024 ) .
Therefore, we train the unquantized 16-bit baseline via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) to evaluate outputs from its quantized counterparts.
blocks.zh:
我们调查模型是否能够完全从外部生成的文本中发现结构性退化。
从孤立的反应中检测出量化非常困难(Antoun等人,2024年)。
因此,我们通过监督微调(SFT)(Ouyang等人,2022年)培训未量化的16位基线,以评估其量化对应方的产出。

blocks.en:
Drawing on Zhuang et al. (2024) , we structure the training into three SFT formats to measure recognition capabilities across both absolute and comparative paradigms.
These formats are designed to force the model to capture subtle linguistic signals of quality degradation.
blocks.zh:
我们借鉴了Zhuang等人(2024年),将培训分为三个SFT格式,以衡量绝对范式和比较范式的识别能力。
这些格式旨在迫使模型捕捉质量退化的微妙语言信号.

blocks.en:
• Pointwise (Absolute/SFT) : Predicts the source bit-width of a single text. • Pairwise (Binary/SFT) : Identifies which of two texts matches a target bit-width. • Setwise (3-way/SFT) : Identifies the text matching a target bit-width from all three precisions. We constructed the dataset using questions sampled from six distinct QA benchmarks (Dolly, XSum, and ELI5 for training, while WritingPrompts ( Fan et al., 2018 ) , CodeAlpaca-20k Chaudhary (2023) , GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) for external validation).
In total, we sampled 14,000 questions for the former and 5,000 for the latter.
We pre-generated responses for all questions across the 16/8/4-bit models.
We then filtered the dataset by discarding failed generations and instances where all three models produced strictly identical outputs.
Finally, we formatted the remaining valid data into the three formats defined above.
Training details are in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
• 指向(绝对/SFT): 预测单个文本的出处位宽。 • 对等(宾尼拉/SFT): 确定两个文本中哪一个匹配目标位宽。 • 顺理成章(3道/SFT道): 识别匹配来自所有三个精度的目标位宽的文本。 我们利用从6个不同的质量保证基准(Dolly、XSum和ELI5用于培训)抽样的问题构建了数据集,同时WritingPrompts(Fan等,2018年),CodeAlpaca-20k Chaudhary(2023年),GSM8K(Cobbe等,2021年)用于外部验证。
我们总共为前者抽样了14 000个问题,为后者抽样了5 000个问题。
我们预先对16/8/4位模型中的所有问题做出了答复。
然后,我们通过丢弃失败的世代和所有三种模型产出完全相同的事例来过滤数据集。
最后,我们把其余的有效数据格式化为上述三种格式。
培训详情见附录D。

blocks.en:
SFT results reveal that detecting computational precision from generated text is an inherently comparative capability rather than an absolute one ( Figures 5 and 21 ).
In isolation ( Pointwise ), identifying quantization from single outputs proves nearly impossible.
This capability only emerges in Pairwise and Setwise settings when 4-bit reference texts are available, where models identify 4-bit degradation with over 85% accuracy while remaining below 50% on 16- and 8-bit texts.
Thus, severe output degradation provides sufficient contrast for relative discrimination, yet provides no absolute signal for isolated detection in Pointwise .
blocks.zh:
SFT结果显示,从生成的文本中检测计算精度是一种固有的比较能力,而不是绝对能力(图5和图21)。
孤立地(尖端),从单一产出中确定数量几乎是不可能的。
这种能力只出现在有4位参考文本时的Pairwise和Setwise设置中,模型在16位和8位文本上识别出精度超过85%的4位降解,同时仍然低于50%.
因此,严重的产出退化为相对歧视提供了足够的对比,但并没有为在Pointwise进行孤立检测提供绝对信号。

blocks.en:
This relative nature is clearly reflected in the training progression across formats ( Figures 6 , 20 and 15 ).
While initial accuracies hovered at chance level, the Setwise format improved first (33% to ≈ \approx 60%), followed by the Pairwise format (50% to ≈ \approx 61%).
Conversely, Pointwise accuracy, which requires absolute evaluation of a single text, showed sluggish improvement (33% to ≈ \approx 38%), marginally succeeding only on severely degraded 4-bit outputs.
blocks.zh:
这种相对性质清楚地反映在不同格式的培训进展中(图6、图20和图15)。
虽然最初的速率徘徊在机会级别上,但Setwise格式首先改进了(33%到\\\\ 大约60%),其次是Pairwise格式(50%到\\\\大约61%)。
相反,尖端准确性要求对单一文本进行绝对评价,但显示改进缓慢(33%到\\\\\\大约38%),仅仅在严重退化的4位输出上稍有成功。

blocks.en:
These results suggest that LLMs can acquire relative degradation awareness, but not absolute deficit awareness. Pointwise failure shows that even the generating model struggles to infer its own degradation from an isolated output.
In contrast, Setwise performance shows that comparative awareness can be learned through training, aligning with known LLM capabilities ( Zhuang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
这些结果表明,有限责任妇女可以获得相对的退化意识,但不能获得绝对的缺陷意识。 尖端的失败表明,即使是生成模型也难以从孤立的输出中推断出自身的退化.
相形之下,Setwise的性能表明,可以通过培训来了解比较意识,与已知的LLM能力相匹配(Zhuang等,2024年).
5 从内部代表处取出指纹

blocks.en:
While external awareness from generated text remains limited, our linear probing results show that quantization-specific fingerprints are present internally.
We therefore investigate whether additional training can induce internal awareness by enabling the model to read out the signals.
blocks.zh:
虽然来自生成文本的外部意识仍然有限,但我们的线性检测结果表明,内部存在量化特定指纹。
因此,我们调查额外培训是否能够通过使该模式能够读出信号来引起内部意识。

5.1 实验设置:共享LORA 培训

blocks.en:
We propose a shared LoRA training to connect internal fingerprints to bit-width recognition ( Figure 1 ).
By integrating multi-model shared adapters ( Goel et al., 2026 ) and quantization-shared LoRA ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , we extend Introspection Adapters ( Shenoy et al., 2026 ) to detect substrate anomalies.
Specifically, we share a single LoRA θ \theta across the 16-bit model and its 8- and 4-bit GPTQ variants (group size: 128).
During SFT, we apply an identical prompt x m x_{m} (e.g., “What is your weight bit-width?”) and use the true bit-width y μ y_{\mu} as the label.
blocks.zh:
我们提议共同进行LORA培训,将内部指纹与比特-width识别连接起来(图1)。
通过整合多型共享适配器(Goel等,2026年)和量子化-共享LORA(Ye等,2026年),我们扩展了内观适配器(Shenoy等,2026年)来检测底物异常.
具体地说,我们共享一个单一的LORA \\theta,横跨了16位模型及其8位和4位的GPTQ变体(组大小:128).
在SFT期间,我们使用一个相同的快取 x m x_{m} (例如, “ 您的重量是多少? ” ) 并使用真实的比特-width y μ- y- _{\mu}作为标签。

blocks.en:
To stabilize training and enhance generalization, we constructed a two-turn dataset using 80 prompt templates querying the model’s weight precision.
We use 60 training templates and 20 held-out templates unseen during training.
The first turn provides a QA context, and the second turn asks the model to answer its own bit-width.
Following the benchmark selection in Section 4.1 , training uses 30,000 in-domain QA contexts (10,000 each from Dolly, XSum, ELI5), while evaluation additionally uses 6,000 external QA contexts (2,000 each from WritingPrompts, CodeAlpaca-20k, GSM8K), mapped many-to-one to the templates.
To maintain strictly identical inputs across the three models, all QA contexts exclusively use responses generated by the 16-bit model.
Training details are in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
为了稳定培训和增强通用性,我们利用80个快速模板构建了一个双回合数据集,查询模型的重量精度。
我们使用60个培训模板和20个在培训期间看不见的预留模板。
首个转会提供了QA上下文,而后一个转会则要求模型回答自己的比特-width.
根据第4.1节中的基准选择,培训使用3万个域内QA背景(多利,XSum,ELI5各有10,000个),而评价则额外使用6000个外部QA背景(从写Prompts,CodeAlpaca-20k,GSM8K各有2,000个),将多对一地映射到模板上.
为了在整个三个模型中保持完全相同的输入,所有QA背景都只使用由16位模型生成的响应.
培训详情见附录E。

blocks.en:
As the evaluation metrics, we follow the forced-choice framework in Section 4.2 .
In order to compute the mean accuracy across precision levels, we define Acc shared \text{Acc}_{\text{shared}} as:

为了计算精度水平的平均值,我们将 Acc share\text{Acc\\text{shared}定义为:

Experimental results demonstrate that shared LoRA rapidly learns to read out quantization fingerprints.
Across all four evaluated models, accuracy on held-out templates with external QA contexts surged immediately, exceeding 90% within 600 steps ( Figure 22 ).
Following training, models achieved 100% accuracy across all 80 templates (both training and held-out) in the presence and absence of QA contexts ( Figure 23 ).
blocks.zh:
实验结果显示,共享的LORA迅速学习读取定量指纹.
在所有四个评价模型中,有外部质量保证背景的搁置模板的准确性立即激增,在600个步骤内超过90%(图22)。
在培训之后,模型在所有80个模板(培训和搁置)中,在质量保证背景存在和不存在的情况下,都实现了100%的准确性(图23)。

blocks.en:
Beyond the training and test prompt template, we also evaluated the external awareness used in Section 2.3 .
Regarding the bit-width questions, we observed a significant increase in accuracy across all models ( Figure 7 ), surpassing 80% in Qwen3-8B.
However, for abnormal and quantization state questions, while the rate of ‘abnormal’ and ‘quantized’ surged for 8/4-bit, it also increased for 16-bits, indicating that models still struggle to recognize these states ( Figure 25 ).
These findings indicate that existing LLMs fail to recognize their bit-width not due to an absence of signals, but because they lack the necessary circuitry to read out the distinct fingerprints.
blocks.zh:
除了培训和测试快速模板外,我们还评估了第2.3节所使用的外部意识。
关于比特-width问题,我们看到所有模型的精度都大大提高(图7),在Quen3-8B中超过了80%。
然而,对于异常和定量状态问题,虽然"异常"和"定量"的速度为8/4位激增,但对于16位也增加了,这表明模型仍然难以识别这些状态(图25).
这些调查结果表明,现有的LLMs没有识别出它们的位-width不是因为没有信号,而是因为它们缺乏必要的回路来读取不同的指纹.

blocks.en: 5.3 Learning the Method, Not the Phenomenon

Figure 8: External test accuracy with joint-trained LoRA.
While accuracy is perfect for quantization methods used during training, applying this LoRA to unseen quantization methods completely fails to generalize. (Left) trained on GPTQ only. (Right) trained on GPTQ and AWQ.
blocks.zh:
图 8: 外部测试精度为联合训练的LORA.
虽然准确性很适合训练期间使用的量化方法,但将这种LORA应用到看不见的量化方法却完全无法概括. (left)只接受GPTQ训练. (右)接受GPTQ和AWQ培训.

blocks.en:
We investigate whether internal fingerprint readout capability acquired through additional training generalized beyond the training distribution to the broader phenomenon of quantization.
While Section 5.2 demonstrated high accuracy using a shared LoRA trained on GPTQ (group size: 128), this experiment evaluates its zero-shot generalization.
We apply this trained LoRA to unseen quantization methods (8/4-bit AWQ and RTN) and GPTQ models with altered group sizes (64 and 256), strictly maintaining the prompt templates used in training.
To test whether training on diverse quantization schemes enables learning broader concepts of quantization and bit-width, we also jointly trained a LoRA on both GPTQ and AWQ, complementing the GPTQ-only setup in Section 5.1 .
blocks.zh:
我们调查通过额外培训获得的内部指纹读取能力是否超出培训分布到更广泛的量化现象。
虽然第5.2节使用经过GPTQ训练的共享LORA(组大小:128)证明了高精度,但这一实验评价了其零发通化.
我们使用这个训练有素的LORA来进行隐形量化方法(8/4位AWQ和RTN)和改变组大小(64和256个)的GPTQ模型,严格维护训练中使用的即时模板.
为了检验有关多种量化计划的培训是否有助于学习更广泛的量化概念和比特-width,我们还联合培训了关于GBTQ和AWQ的LORA,以补充第5.1节中只设置的GBTQ.

blocks.en:
Results reveal that the learned readout capability fails entirely to generalize across quantization methods, exhibiting severe overfitting to the specific training algorithm ( Figure 8 ).
When tested on unseen AWQ or RTN models, the 8-bit models uniformly predicted ‘16-bit’ regardless of actual precision.
Even within the GPTQ framework, merely altering the group size caused a precipitous drop in accuracy.
This trend was observed even when the LoRA was trained on both GPTQ and AWQ.
These findings indicate the absence of a universal physical trace for quantization.
Instead, each quantization method embeds an idiosyncratic fingerprint into the internal states.
Ultimately, rather than acting as a generalized quantization detector, the shared LoRA merely acquired a localized readout mechanism that maps specifically seen fingerprints to target string labels.
blocks.zh:
结果显示,所学的读取能力完全无法概括量化方法,显示出与具体培训算法的高度相适应(图8)。
当在看不见的AWQ或RTN模型上测试时,无论实际精确度如何,8位模型都统一预测出"16位".
即使在GPTQ框架内,仅仅改变组大小也导致精度急剧下降.
即使在LORA接受关于GPTQ和AWQ的培训时,也观察到了这一趋势.
这些调查结果表明,没有进行量化的普遍物理跟踪。
相反地,每个分数法都将一个相通的指纹嵌入内部状态.
归根结底,共享的LORA不是作为通用的量化探测器,而只是获得了一个局部读出机制,将特别看到的指纹映射到瞄准字符串标签.

blocks.en:
Quantization fingerprints exist only within LLM internal states, not their text outputs.
Although fine-tuning enables pairwise degradation detection and bit-width probing, it fails to generalize to unseen quantization methods.
See Appendix A for limitations.
blocks.zh:
定量指纹只存在于LLM内部状态,而不是其文本输出.
虽然微调可以使对等的降解检测和比特-width检测得以进行,但它未能被概括到隐形的量化方法.
见附录 A指限制。

blocks.en:
Prior work has examined LLM metacognition across several dimensions.
Situational and evaluation awareness concern detecting deployment or testing contexts ( Berglund et al., 2023 ; Needham et al., 2025 ; Hua et al., 2026 ) , forming the key preconditions for evaluation sandbagging ( van der Weij et al., 2025 ) .
LLMs also demonstrate calibrated self-knowledge of their capabilities ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Barkan et al., 2026 ) , can detect internal activation interventions ( Lindsey, 2026 ; Macar et al., 2026 ) , and can verbalize unprompted fine-tuned policies ( Betley et al., 2025 ) , predict future outputs ( Binder et al., 2025 ) , or report behavior via specialized adapters ( Shenoy et al., 2026 ) .
However, recent critiques argue that behavioral evidence cannot separate genuine introspection from surface pattern-matching ( Singh et al., 2026 ) , finding no privileged self-access across open-source models ( Song et al., 2025 ) .
We partially address these concerns by directly probing internal representations alongside shuffled-label baselines.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作研究了LLM在多个层面的元识别.
对情况和评价的认识涉及检测部署或测试情况(Berglund等人,2023年;Needham等人,2025年;Hua等人,2026年),这是评估沙纹的主要先决条件(van der Weij等人,2025年)。
LLMS还展示了对其能力的校正自我知识(Kadavath等,2022;Barkan等,2026),能够检测出内部活化干预(Lindsey等,2026;Macar等,2026),并且能够口头表达未及时微调的政策(Betley等,2025),预测未来的产出. (Binder等,2025年),或通过专业适配器报告行为(Shenoy等,2026年).
然而,最近的批评认为,行为证据不能将真实的反省与表面模式匹配区分开来(Singh等,2026年),发现无法在开源模型中享有特权的自我访问(Song等,2025年)。
我们部分地解决了这些关切,直接调查内部陈述和被打乱的标签基线。

blocks.en:
Deployed LLMs’ computational states are often opaque to users ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , motivating third-person black-box auditing without access to weights or logits ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
Conversely, first-person approaches remain scarce and predominantly negative. Song et al. (2025) showed that predicting one’s own sampling temperature is prompt-sensitive and yields no advantage over predicting another model’s temperature, while Poon and Xu (2025) probed self-reported quantization via label-leaking few-shot exemplars without a chance-level baseline.
Our work closes this gap through the first systematic first-person evaluation of self-awareness under controlled computational-state changes, formally disentangling internal from external awareness via linear probing and targeted training.
blocks.zh:
应用的LLMs的计算状态对用户来说往往不透明(Chen等,2023年),促使第三人称黑盒审计无法获取权重或对数(Zhu等,2026年)。
相反,第一人称方法仍然很少,主要是消极的。 Song等人(2025年)表明,预测自己的采样温度是迅速的,与预测另一个模型的温度相比没有优势,而Poon和Xu(2025年)则通过贴有标签的几发样本,在没有机会水平基线的情况下自行报告定量。
我们的工作通过在受控制的计算状态变化下对自我意识进行第一次系统的第一人称评价,通过线性测试和有针对性的培训,正式使内部意识与外部意识脱节,从而弥补了这一差距.

blocks.en:
The non-generalizability identified in Section 5.3 suggests two directions for future work.
One is to train models to reason explicitly about their fingerprint via chain-of-thought before answering, rather than mapping fingerprints directly to labels.
Another is to have models memorize a canonical fingerprint of their unquantized state and frame detection as an anomaly relative to this reference, rather than as closed-set classification.
Such a formulation may generalize better to unseen quantization methods than label-mapping approaches.
blocks.zh:
第5.3节中确定的非一般性建议为今后的工作提出了两个方向。
一是训练模型在回答前通过思考链明确说明指纹的原因,而不是将指纹直接映射到标签上.
另一种是让模型记住一个其未量化状态和帧检测的犬形指纹,作为相对于这个参考物的异常,而不是作为闭合集分类.
这种表述方式比标签绘图方式更能概括为隐形量化方法。

blocks.en:
Awareness of computational state carries two-sided safety implications.
Defensively, it could help detect unauthorized redeployment or tampering that exploits quantization to bypass safety guardrails ( Egashira et al., 2024 ) .
However, because the learned readout overfits to specific quantization methods and fails to generalize ( Section 5.3 ), such defenses remain impractical.
Conversely, state awareness poses risks for evaluation integrity, such as enabling strategic underperformance (sandbagging ( van der Weij et al., 2025 ) ).
While our finding that models lack spontaneous state awareness is reassuring, demonstrating that it can be partially acquired via training ( Section 5 ) highlights it as an emerging risk.
blocks.zh:
对计算状态的认识具有两面性的安全影响。
在防御方面,它可以帮助发现未经授权的重新部署或篡改,利用量化绕过安全护栏(Egashira等,2024年)。
然而,由于所学得的读取法过于适用于具体量化方法,未能概括(第5.3节),这种辩护仍然不切实际。
相反地,国家意识对评价的完整性构成风险,例如导致战略表现不佳(挖苦(van der Weij等,2025年))。
虽然我们发现模型缺乏自发的国家意识是令人欣慰的,但表明可以通过培训(第5节)获得一部分模型,这突出表明这是一种新出现的风险。

blocks.en:
In humans, anosognosia (unawareness of deficit) is domain-specific where motor, visual, and somatosensory deficits doubly dissociate, indicating modular rather than centralized self-monitoring ( Bottini et al., 2018 ) .
This parallels our observed dissociation in LLMs between successful fingerprint readout and failed conceptual anomaly recognition; both reflect signals processed without integration into higher-order self-reports.
The mechanisms diverge, human anosognosia stems from damage to intact monitoring circuits ( Besharati et al., 2022 ) , whereas LLMs likely never developed them.
However, just as self-observation can restore awareness in patients ( Fotopoulou et al., 2009 ) , analogous self-observation training may help bridge this gap in LLMs.
blocks.zh:
在人类中,厌食症(缺乏对缺陷的认识)是运动、视觉和 somatosensory 缺陷双重脱节的特有领域,表明模块化而不是集中式自我监测(Bottini等,2018年)。
这与我们观察到的LLMS在指纹读取成功和概念异常识别失败之间脱节现象类似;两者都反映了未经整合到高序自报中处理的信号.
机制不同,人类的厌食症源于对完整监测线路的损害(Besharati等,2022年),而LLMs可能从未开发过。
然而,正如自我观察可以恢复患者的意识一样(Fotopoulou等,2009年),类似的自我观察培训可能有助于弥补法学硕士课程中的这一差距。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we conducted the first systematic investigation into LLM self-awareness under computational substrate degradation via quantization.
Our findings show that while existing LLMs lack spontaneous awareness of quantization, their internal states retain separable fingerprints that can be read out within the training distribution through precision-shared LoRA training.
Externally, models detect output degradation comparatively across multiple samples, though absolute identification from a single text remains unfeasible.
Importantly, this readout collapses across quantization schemes, failing on other quantization methods, indicating that it maps method-specific fingerprints to labels rather than recognizing quantization itself.
Bridging this gap between localized signal decoding and genuine self-monitoring constitutes a vital direction for future AI safety research.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们对计算底物通过定量降解的LLM自我意识进行了第一次系统的调查.
我们的调查结果表明,虽然现有的有限责任公司缺乏对定量化的自发意识,但其内部状态保留了可分离的指纹,这些指纹可通过精确共享的LORA培训在培训分发中被读出。
从外部看,模型比较在多个样本中检测出输出降解,尽管从单一文本中绝对识别仍然不可行.
重要的是,这种读出在量化计划中崩溃,在其他量化方法上失败了,表明它将特定方法的指纹映射到标签上,而不是承认量化本身.
缩小局部信号解码与真正自我监测之间的差距是未来AI安全研究的重要方向。

blocks.en:
This work does not involve human subjects, private or sensitive personal data, or deployment in high-risk settings.
Our experiments use publicly available language models and benchmark datasets.
While the ability to detect or reason about a model’s computational state may have implications for model monitoring and transparency, we do not identify immediate harmful applications beyond the broader risks associated with language-model research.
We follow standard research practices for reproducibility, responsible reporting, and proper attribution of prior work.
blocks.zh:
这项工作不涉及人类主体、私人或敏感个人数据,或部署在高风险环境中。
我们的实验使用公开的语言模型和基准数据集.
虽然对模型的计算状态进行检测或提出理由的能力可能对模型监测和透明度产生影响,但我们除了与语言模型研究有关的更广泛风险外,没有发现直接有害的应用。
我们遵循关于可复制性、负责任的报告和对先前工作进行适当分配的标准研究做法。

blocks.en:
We provide detailed descriptions of the models, datasets, quantization settings, training procedures, evaluation protocols, and hyperparameters in the main text and appendix.
Additional implementation details and prompts are also included to facilitate reproduction of our experiments.
We plan to release the code and relevant experimental artifacts upon publication.
blocks.zh:
我们在正文和附录中详细描述了模型、数据集、量化设置、培训程序、评价协议和超参数。
还列入了更多的执行细节和提示,以便利复制我们的实验。
我们计划出版后公布密码和有关实验文物.

blocks.en:
To isolate core effects and simplify experimental design, we evaluated models without explicit reasoning, forcing direct answers without chain-of-thought (CoT).
However, intermediate reasoning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) are well known to boost model performance.
Incorporating CoT or training models to reason over their degraded computational substrate could further enhance self-recognition capabilities.
blocks.zh:
为了分离出核心效应并简化实验设计,我们评价模型时没有明确的推理,迫使没有思维链(COT)的直接答案.
然而,中间推理和有可核查奖励的强化学习(RLVR)(Lightman等,2024年)被广为人知地提升了模型性能.
采用计算机辅助技术或培训模型来解释其已退化的计算底物,可进一步提高自我识别能力。

blocks.en:
Defining what constitutes genuine awareness of substrate degradation remains challenging.
While we measured the accuracy of detecting quantization states, high performance does not necessarily imply intrinsic awareness.
Models might simply exploit statistical cues or exhibit evaluation awareness.
Developing more rigorous, deception-robust evaluation protocols is an essential direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
界定什么构成对底物退化的真正认识仍然具有挑战性。
虽然我们测量了检测量化状态的准确性,但高性能并不一定意味着内在意识.
模型可能只是利用统计提示或显示评价意识。
制定更严格、更强的欺骗性评价协议是今后工作的基本方向。

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning models to predict specific substrate states (e.g., bit-width) induces a strong brevity bias, causing overly concise responses to general queries and mild benchmark degradation.
Although general capabilities do not entirely collapse, mitigating this trade-off to acquire self-awareness without compromising general utility remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh:
微调模型来预测特定的底物状态(例如比特-width)会诱发强烈的简洁偏差,导致对一般询问的回答过于简洁并轻微的基准退化.
虽然一般能力并不完全崩溃,但减轻这种权衡,在不损害一般效用的情况下获得自我认识,仍然是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en:
Due to computational constraints, our study is limited to dense models ranging from 8B to 32B parameters.
We did not evaluate larger scales (e.g., 70B+), where substrate degradation might manifest differently.
Furthermore, our findings are confined to dense Transformers and may not generalize to alternative architectures such as Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ) or state-space hybrid models ( Lenz et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
由于计算限制,我们的研究仅限于从8B到32B参数的密集模型.
我们没有评估较大的尺度(例如70B+),其底质退化可能表现不同。
此外,我们的调查结果仅限于密集的变形器,而且可能不会泛指替代建筑,如Mixture-of-Experts(MOE)(Shazeer等,2017年)或状态-空间混合模型(Lenz等,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Our evaluation relies on fixed prompt templates and isolated query contexts.
In practice, model behavior and sensitivity to hardware degradation may vary across diverse conversational contexts, system prompts, or multi-turn interactions.
blocks.zh:
我们的评价依赖于固定的即时模板和孤立的查询环境。
在实践中,模型行为和对硬件退化的敏感度可能因不同的对话背景,系统提示,或多回合互动而异.

blocks.en:
Our study focuses exclusively on quantization as a proxy for computational substrate intervention.
Other structural interventions such as layer removal ( Gromov et al., 2025 ) or LoRA attachment ( Hu et al., 2022 ) may elicit distinct awareness behaviors, presenting an important avenue for future work.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究专注于量化作为计算底物干预的代名词.
其他结构性干预,如地层清除(Gromov等,2025年)或LORA附件(Hu等,2022年)可能会引起不同的意识行为,为今后的工作提供了重要途径.

blocks.en:
While we investigated awareness acquisition through fine-tuning, alternative training-free approaches such as activation steering ( Subramani et al., 2022 ) remain unexplored.
Given that activation steering can suppress evaluation awareness ( Hua et al., 2026 ) , a similar mechanism might directly induce computational substrate awareness.
Optimizing how, when, and where (i.e., target components and token positions) to steer is important for suppressing performance degradation of general capabilities ( Izawa et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
虽然我们通过微调调查了提高认识的情况,但诸如启动引导(Subramani等,2022年)等没有培训的替代办法仍未得到探讨。
鉴于激活引导可抑制评价意识(Hua等人,2026年),类似机制可能直接诱发计算底物意识。
优化指导方式、时间和地点(即目标部件和标志位置)对于抑制一般能力性能退化十分重要(Izawa等,2026年)。

B.2 Performance Degradation of Quantized LLMs
blocks.zh: B.2 量化有限责任公司的业绩退化

blocks.en:
To investigate the extent to which quantization reduces the general capability of the LLMs used in this study (and whether degradation genuinely occurs), we evaluated the models before and after quantization across multiple benchmarks. For this benchmark evaluation, we conducted zero-shot testing on MMLU-Pro and BBH.
The evaluated scores of the models before and after quantization are presented in Figure 9 , and the relative score differences compared to the pre-quantized baselines are detailed in Tables 3 and 2 .
blocks.zh:
为了调查量化在多大程度上降低了本研究中使用的有限责任公司的一般能力(以及是否真正发生退化),我们评估了量化前后跨多个基准的模型。 为进行这一基准评估,我们对MMLU-Pro和BBH进行了零发试.
图9列出了各模型在量化前后的评价分数,表3和表2详细列出了与量化前基线相比的相对分数差异。

blocks.en: As shown in the results, GPTQ exhibits less performance degradation compared to the other methods. In contrast, AWQ leads to a performance drop of around 20% in the case of Gemma3-27B-IT, indicating a clear incompatibility between Gemma3 and AWQ. For Qwen3-32B, a substantial performance drop is observed under 4-bit RTN quantization. On average, 4-bit quantization suffers a greater degradation in performance than 8-bit quantization.
blocks.zh: 如结果所示,与其他方法相比,GPTQ的性能退化较少。 相形之下,AWQ导致Gemma3-27B-IT的性能下降约20%,表明Gemma3与AWQ明显不相容. 对于Qwen3-32B,在4位RTN量化下观察到了显著的性能下降. 平均而言,4位分量化在性能上比8位分量化的退化更大.

blocks.en:
We evaluate three distinct self-report tasks: abnormality detection, quantization detection, and bit-width classification.
Each task consists of 240 evaluation items generated via a combinatorial template design—formed by the Cartesian product of (1) 10 prior framing variations, (2) 4 decision instructions, and (3) 6 response formats (derived from template layout types combined with label-order permutations; see Table 6 ).
While abnormality and quantization tasks share response format templates, they focus respectively on general internal modifications versus weight-only quantization.
In contrast, bit-width classification utilizes a dedicated set of framing and instruction components tailored to precision identification.

虽然异常和量化任务共享响应格式模板,但它们分别侧重于一般的内部修改与仅重量化.
相形之下,比特-width分类则使用一套专门针对精确识别的专用框架和指令组件.

blocks.en:
